While Li is busy wiggling his way into Ihn's good graces, I'm stuck watching the dead crawl.

The ruins are spilling over with Risen. If we can't claim the city on our own, I wouldn't be surprised if the "citizens of Old Kaineng" did the work for us. They're already stirring up trouble in Grub Lane. Couple of casualties a week...and most of the bodies find their way back to the ruins to rot.

You'd think after a hundred years their numbers would start going down, but...they're not. More and more Risen crawl out of every shaft of the drowned Undercity like maggots from a corpse. I shudder to think how many are lurking beneath my feet at this very moment.

It's not glamorous work, but if I can find the source of this magic...whatever it is...we might be able to win the war before it's even begun. But that might be wishful thinking.

Chapter 23

"You've had weeks to work this mark," Legionnaire Breakheart growled through his comm. "You mean to tell me you've learned NOTHING of the Zephyrites' secrets? Not even how to do that lightning thing?"

"I've gained Heart's trust. I've been invited to the order." Leon snapped. "The Aspects will come. I just need time."
 
"You have until the festival ends next week, Stealheart. Don't disappoint me."

Leon closed his eyes. He could get everything in that week, of course. But did he really want to return to collecting commendations for Ash, letting his Heart sail off into the sky, perhaps forever? Even now, he missed the glint in Heart's eye, the sun in his smile, the wind in his hair, the lightning of his touch.

No! Whatever his Legionnaire wanted, it could wait. For the only Aspect that mattered...was love.

**The following report collects the content of Project Omega subject Zipp's audio logs, as transcribed by project specialist Keelli, for Overseer Kuda's eyes only. Unauthorized access will be reported and prosecuted according to Inquest compliance protocols.**  
  
*Entry 1*  
Here I am, again, trapped in yet another arrangement that is not of my own making. It's not like I'm ungrateful, Overseer. You are listening to these, I hope? I just...I've never really fit in anywhere. I don't expect this experiment is going to be all that different. I've spent the past eleven years trying to figure out where I belong, and the Inquest have given me a lot since... Well, since what happened at Lion's Arch. But still, I feel adrift. That's what got me to sign up for this expedition to Castora in the first place. I guess I hope that it will give me something that's been missing...  
  
*Entry 2*  
I...I feel freakin' amazing! Ha! I've always had a lot of energy, Ma used to say so all the time, but even on my best day I've never felt as good as I do now. I have so many ideas. It's like my head is a golem power core running on overdrive! I can't seem to sit still, either. I have to keep moving or I feel like it'll all go away. And I don't want it to go away! I can feel it. I've got to move.  
  
*Entry 3*  
So fast. I'm fast. I can't think straight. The thoughts. One comes in. Then another comes in. And another. It's like...I can't stop. There are too many. It's not... Ah, Overseer? Is this normal? Am I...okay? Do you think... What... It's not... I MUST MOVE!  
  
*Entry 4*  
I figured it out. I think. Need to move. And wow, can I move! The amalgam tech taught me. I can use it to expend energy. It helps. Clears my head. Helps me. For a little while, at least. Then I have to move again.   
  
We're going to some temple. With Overseer Kuda. And the others. Going to run there! I can't wait! Can't wait! Let's go! Go! Go!
